status: Design artifacts only; no persistence or execution architecture implemented

operations.inputs: Text plus explicitly declared input state
operations.test: Empty array and absent input key must yield different evidence states

operations.inputs: Bound source image and task-scoped identity/style properties
operations.invariants: Source binding is not verified identity or canonical approval
operations.test: Identity-preservation request survives absent mask controls and unknown output state

operations.inputs: Source images with distinct role/property bindings
operations.invariants: Placement, scale, perspective, occlusion, lighting permissions and preservation stored independently; no invented layers
operations.output: Candidate still and all producer edges
operations.test: Room/plant convergence round-trip retains both sources and the allowed relighting change

operations.inputs: Base asset, named changed property and preservation constraints; optional explicit mask
operations.invariants: Edit intent separate from mask and literal is_inpaint state
operations.output: Derivative candidate; inferred version until explicit decision
operations.test: A false inpaint flag and local-edit wording must coexist without creating a mask

operations.inputs: Source asset, raw camera/expansion controls and requested framing
operations.invariants: Model-specific units, values and absent/null/zero retained
operations.output: Candidate with changed framing request; no measured result
operations.test: Zero angle creates no active reframe claim; explicit nonzero model-scoped control does

operations.inputs: Source asset, recorded dimensions, literal adapter controls
operations.invariants: Equal recorded dimensions do not establish source pixel size or enlargement; no quality claim
operations.test: Equal-field Topaz job cannot become an enlargement from its model name alone

integrity_requirements: Unavailable values remain null and empty values retain state
No successful outcome or approval inferred from an attachment
Resolved edges require existing producer job; missing producer retained as unknown
Raw parameters stored beside classification; never execute source text
Explicit actor and decision event required to approve an output; use alone is further work

experiment.task: Same approved sources and named composition/change task
experiment.changed_factor: Staged preparation or local correction, one factor per experiment
experiment.controls: Same sources, literal model/version and declared parameters; predeclared repetitions and budget
experiment.review: Human task rubric for required changes/invariants, explicit acceptance event; media review belongs to a new authorised experiment
experiment.limit: Proposed, not conducted; no benefit, cost or failure claim from this archive
